scripts.dev: npm run prepare-dist && concurrently "tsx watch src/server/index.ts" "esbuild src/client/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/client/main.js --sourcemap --watch"
scripts.build: npm run prepare-dist && esbuild src/client/main.ts --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/client/main.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json
